scientific_limitations: Only compactly supported Euler characteristics are controlled; individual Betti and Hodge numbers are not.
The universal symmetric-product Euler sequence depends only on the integer chi_c(X), so the theorem does not distinguish varieties with equal Euler characteristic.
The prime-adic reduction is concise after the classical power-structure identity is known, so an unindexed arithmetic formulation may contain the same consequence.
title: A prime-carry law for symmetric-product Euler characteristics
